content.what_completed: The 0264 roadmap payoff: when U1-U6 land, the T4OffLE/LF/LG/LI squeeze theorems get their bridge premise converted from a citation to a reference to the in-body identity - DONE, all four modules, seven companion theorems, original stated premises untouched (the cited-premise versions remain for provenance). 0262's 'given its own two external premises (A2c bridge + S3 face) and (iii) the pin' is now half-internal: the EM-squeeze class is infeasible at every run GIVEN its face and pin premises - one of the two external premises is a theorem in body, no RH claim, no zero data anywhere in the new code.
content.identity_theorem_mechanics: Both sides analytic on a2c_Dcut (U = {Re s > -1} \ {1}): W-side from analyticOn_riemannZeta (zeta on {1}^c) + AnalyticOnNhd sub/add; P4-side from the U5 differentiability layer + analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn (open domain). Equality on {s | 1 < s.re} from the already-landed P4Limit.p4_identity (the Re s > 1 Euler-Maclaurin law, machine proven). EqOn follows on the whole preconnected U from one neighbourhood of the basepoint 2+2i (eventuallyEq via the open-set membership). The off-point corollary reads the identity at t4l_sOffL t d0, whose membership in U was U0 (a2c_sL_in_Dcut).
content.residue_unchanged: hOffCPT2: the infeasibility record is a record about the squeeze's premise structure; the squeeze's S3 face and pin remain premises (they are the squeeze's own world-claims). Route (a) data conveyor (B24/B25 board under the watcher at the TEN family contact) and route (b) genuinely-asymmetric EM families (fill engine and tail wall at DIFFERENT scales, connected by a per-run transfer certificate) remain the two open frontiers for a discharge outside the squeeze class.

Lean 4.33.1 toolchain lessons harvested in this unit (probe-verified before relying on them): (1) HasDerivAt.comp / HasDerivAt.const_cpow fail to elaborate when the derivative hypotheses are on nested anonymous functions (the unifier leaves the outer function as a meta) - decompose through hasStrictDerivAt_const_cpow (Pow/Deriv.lean, present in this checkout: const_cpow / cpow / cpow_const family all there) + an explicit derivative-equality bridge, never convert! on the derivative; (2) for functions, (f + g) IS rfl-equal to (fun x => f x + g x) - Pi-instance add is reducible - so an eta-bridge is a one-line `rfl` and a bare `exact ... .add ...` works once the goal's cast is normalized (norm_cast for (k+1:Complex) vs ((k+1:Real):Complex)); (3) Path.ofLine values: bind the path with `set gamma : Path x ax := ...` so dsimp [gamma, Path.ofLine, Function.comp; simp [Set.Icc] unfolds gamma t to the segment formula - `have` bindings are dsimp-opaque; (4) EqOn's anonymous strict-implicit binder (set E := {x | ...}): `hU x hx` does NOT elaborate in this toolchain (the point stays a meta and x lands in the membership slot) - bridge with `show (forall (x : C), x in U -> f x = g x) from hU` then apply; (5) import M.N in this toolchain makes N's names available UNQUALIFIED - the module prefixes `N.x` and `M.N.x` do NOT resolve as namespacing (probe-verified: #check a2c_sL_bridge works, #check P8A2c.a2c_sL_bridge fails with unknownIdentifier even though the olean contains the declaration); (6) norm_cast alone closes simple cast-positivity goals such that `norm_cast; omega` leaves omega with no goal (No goals to be solved) - use bare norm_cast where it suffices; (7) docstrings must start with a single space after /-- (two spaces fires the docstring linter and the lint-as-error fails the module build, cascading as unknownIdentifier downstream on stale oleans - if you see unknownIdentifier on a fresh import, check the imported module's last build for lint-as-errors first); (8) simpa does not normalize a - (b - c) to a - b + c - bridge with an explicit `by ring` equality + .trans.

Incident log: 7 build-red rounds between the U5/U6 insertion and green (each round a different elaborator wall: Ne.of_pos unknown constant, HasDerivAt.comp unification, Icc double-space parsing, path dsimp opacity, EqOn strict-implicit application, Pi-eta mismatch, module-open semantics). All resolved by the decompose-and-bridge idiom documented in notes(1)-(8); no reverts of landed U0-U4 content, no signature changes to any committed theorem.

Next units (route (a) / route (b) frontier, per the 0262 residue and the 0255 matrix): (a) board conveyor continues under the watcher (TEN family contact) - data side, out of this agent's immediate scope; (b) the genuinely-asymmetric EM family feasibility question - whether a fill engine at run N1 and a tail wall at run N2 (N1 != N2, different (1/2 C^-1 t^-2) scales) connected by a per-run transfer certificate can carry the S3 face at the fill run where the decoupled squeeze cannot - this is the next research surface and, if the answer is a positive measured family, its own formal module with a transfer-certificate premise structure mirroring T4OffLE's but at two runs.
